decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Plan 1a, plan 1, plan 2a, plan 2, plan 3a, plan 3 received on 25 September 2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Any activity within the premises associated with the use hereby permitted shall not cause noise to be emitted from the premises in excess of 45dBA as measured at the nearest residential boundary to the application site
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 7am to 11pm.

Condition : 5 - The premises shall be used for A3 use as a cafe, wine bar or restaurant and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A3 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 6 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the premises at any time.
Condition : 7 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Variation of Conditions 3a (opening hours) & 4 (use) to Planning Application 00083/734/P18 dated 24/10/1990 for Continued use of premises as Wine Bar/ Restaurant
